orthogonal_direct_sum_rule.theorem: If L = L+ perp L- and f = 1_{L+} + (-1_{L-}), then O(L,f) =~ O(L+) x O(L-)

gluing_overlattice_rule.theorem: For overlattice L of L+ perp L-, O(L,f) =~ Stab_{O(L+) x O(L-)}(H_L)

enriques_involution_k3.fixed_sublattice: L_+ =~ U + U(2) + E8(-2) (Enriques lattice N)
